prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original full-body front-facing character concept in high-end feature-film 3D CGI for animal financial fable AstralPact. Character named 熊大笑, nicknamed 大笑师傅. An unmistakably adult middle-aged male anthropomorphic GIANT PANDA, round kind face, recognizable black eye patches, round black ears, white and black individually resolved fur. Stout friendly mature build, believable adult proportions, two strong legs and grounded feet, NOT a baby panda. Warm slightly rueful smile, wise gentle eyes with a subtle concerned knowing expression: a modest man trying quietly to warn ordinary people against deception, approachable and not a clown or villain.
THREE essential signature props, all extremely clear:
1. A SMALL EARTH-GLOBE TOY securely perched ON TOP OF HIS HEAD between the ears, blue ocean and recognizable green continent shapes, tiny brass-toned cradle/base on a discreet headband so structurally supported. Globe roughly one quarter head width, playful but tasteful, entire globe visible.
2. A vintage compact PORTABLE RADIO hanging at his waist from a leather belt, on viewer-right hip, outward facing: weathered brown casing, round speaker grille, tuning scale, two knobs and a short aerial, visibly a radio rather than a purse.
3. RIGHT BESIDE THE RADIO hangs a separate substantial ivory/wooden rectangular tag on a cord, front plane facing camera and unobstructed. The tag has exactly TWO CLEAR BLACK CHINESE CHARACTERS: “好人”. Arrange vertically 好 above 人, large correctly formed plain printed characters, not scribbles. No other words anywhere.
Costume proposal: plain well-tailored warm grey-blue Chinese stand-collar jacket with simple frog buttons, cream inner collar, dark charcoal straight trousers, comfortable black cloth shoes, slightly worn everyday fabric. Modest and approachable, no royal gold embroidery. His dark furry hands relaxed in front near abdomen without hiding radio or tag. No extra props, no cane, no spectacle glasses, no hats competing with globe.
Full head-to-toe portrait, vertical 2:3, leave margin around globe and both feet, neutral warm grey studio background, soft natural floor contact shadow. Attached reference is ONLY for physically based rendering and cinematic quality, do NOT inherit dragon identity, horns, jewelry or royal gown. High-end feature-film CGI, physically based materials, individually resolved fur, woven cloth texture, distinct radio metal/leather/plastic and printed wood tag, soft warm key and subtle cool fill, crisp natural detail, realistic volume yet appealing art direction. Not photoreal human, no human face, no toy plastic fur, no painterly smears, no watermark, no collage.
